table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Icode,
	type,
	Postdate,
	date,
	salesman,
	title,
	godown,
	itemname,
	aliasname,
	UTN,	
	HeaderNo,
	HeaderInvNo
FROM
	(select
		purdetail.Icode,
		type = 'PV-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), purledger.purinvcode))),
		Postdate = purledger.postdate,
		date = purledger.postdate,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title = Case When purcatcode = 1 or purcatcode = 2 or purcatcode = 7 or purcatcode = 8  Then 
				(Select accounts.name From accounts
				Where accounts.acccode = purledger.suppcode)	
			Else 'Opening Purchase'	
			End,
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = purdetail.gcode),
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = purdetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = purdetail.icode),
		UTN=isnull(purdetail.purutn, 0),	
		HeaderNo=PurLedger.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=PurLedger.HeaderInvNo
	from  purledger, purdetail, users	  
	where purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and	
			purdetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
			purledger.Posted = 'Y' and 
			purledger.salesmancode = users.usercode
	UNION ALL
	select 
		issuedetail.Icode,
		type = 'IS-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), IssueHeader.issueinvcode))),
		Postdate = IssueHeader.postdate,
		date = IssueHeader.date,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title=( Case RecipientCode When 1 Then (Select Name From Department Where DeptCode=issueheader.deptcode) When 2 Then (Select Name From Accounts Where AccCode = issueheader.AccCode) When 3 Then (Select Name From Accounts Where AccCode = issueheader.AccCode) When 4 Then (Select Name From SalesMan Where SalesManCode = issueheader.RecipientSalesMan ) End),
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = issuedetail.gcode),
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = issuedetail.icode) ,
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = issuedetail.icode),
		UTN=isnull(issuedetail.issueutn, 0),	
		HeaderNo=IssueHeader.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=IssueHeader.HeaderInvNo
	from  Issueheader, issuedetail,users
	where issueheader.issueinvcode = issuedetail.issueinvcode and	
			issuedetail.icode IN (:ar_icode)	and 	
			issueheader.salesmancode = users.usercode
	UNION ALL
	select 
		prdetail.Icode,
		type = 'PR-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), prledger.prinvcode))),
		Postdate = prledger.postdate,
		date = prledger.date,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title = Case When prcatcode = 4 or prcatcode = 5 Then (Select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode = prledger.suppcode)	
				Else 'Opening Purchase Return'	
				End,
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = prdetail.gcode),
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = prdetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = prdetail.icode),
		UTN=isnull(prdetail.prutn, 0),	
		HeaderNo=PrLedger.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=PrLedger.HeaderInvNo
	from prledger, prdetail, users
	where  prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode and	
			 prdetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
			 prledger.salesmancode = users.usercode
	UNION ALL
	select 
		saledetail.Icode,
		type = Case  saleledger.salecatcode	 When  3 Then 'CS-' Else  'CR-' End + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(8), saleledger.saleinvcode))),
		Postdate = saleledger.postdate,
		date = saleledger.date,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title= (Select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode = saleledger.custcode),
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = saledetail.gcode),
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = saledetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = saledetail.icode),
		UTN=isnull(saledetail.saleutn,0),	
		HeaderNo=SaleLedger.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=SaleLedger.HeaderInvNo
	from   saleledger, saledetail, users
	where  saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and	
		 saledetail.icode IN (:ar_icode)		and 	
		 saleledger.salesmancode = users.usercode
	UNION ALL
	select 
		srdetail.Icode,
		type = Case  srledger.srcatcode	When 8 Then 'CSR-'	Else 'CRR-' End + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), srledger.srinvcode))),
		Postdate = srledger.postdate,
		date = srledger.postdate,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title= Case When srcatcode = 6 or srcatcode = 7 Then (Select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode = srledger.custcode)
				Else 'Cash Sale Return' End,
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = srdetail.gcode),
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = srdetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = srdetail.icode),
		UTN=isnull(srdetail.srutn, 0),	
		HeaderNo=SrLedger.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=SrLedger.HeaderInvNo
	from srledger, srdetail, users
	where  srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode and	
			 srdetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
			 srledger.posted = 'Y' and
			 srledger.salesmancode = users.usercode
	UNION ALL
	select
		duesatisfydetail.Icode,
		type = 'DS-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode))),
		Postdate = DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyDate,
		date = DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyDate,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title=Case	When (Select saleledger.salecatcode from saleledger
						Where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode) = 1 
						or(Select saleledger.salecatcode from saleledger
					Where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode) = 2 Then 
						(Select accounts.name from accounts, saleledger 
						where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode  and 
						accounts.acccode = saleledger.custcode)	
				Else 'Cash Sale' /*Retail Sale Cash*/	End,
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = DueSatisfyDetail.gcode),
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = duesatisfydetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = duesatisfydetail.icode),
		UTN=isnull(duesatisfydetail.duesatisfyutn, 0),	
		HeaderNo=NULL,
		HeaderInvNo=NULL
	from   DueSatisfyHeader, DueSatisfydetail, users
	where  DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyCode = DueSatisfyDetail.DueSatisfyCode and	
		 DueSatisfyDetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
		 DueSatisfyHeader.usercode = users.usercode
	UNION ALL
	select 
		duedeletedetail.Icode,
		type = 'DD-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode))),
		Postdate = DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyDate,
		date = DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyDate,
		salesman = users.username,
		title=case When (Select saleledger.salecatcode from saleledger
						Where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode) = 1 
					 or(Select saleledger.salecatcode from saleledger
						Where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode) = 2 Then
							(Select accounts.name from accounts, saleledger 
							where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode  and 
							accounts.acccode = saleledger.custcode)	
				Else 'Cash Sale'
				End,
		godown = '',
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = duedeletedetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = duedeletedetail.icode),
		UTN=9999999,
		HeaderNo=NULL,
		HeaderInvNo=NULL
	from   DueSatisfyHeader, DueDeletedetail, users	  	
	where  DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyCode = DueDeleteDetail.DueSatisfyCode and	
		 DueDeleteDetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
		 DueSatisfyHeader.usercode = users.usercode
	UNION ALL
	select 
		adjdetail.Icode,
		type = Case  adjheader.adjcatcode	When 1 Then 'AI-' Else 'AD-' End + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), adjheader.adjcode))),
		Postdate = adjheader.posteddate,
		date = adjheader.posteddate,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title= (Select adjcategory.name from adjcategory where adjcategory.adjcatcode = adjheader.adjcatcode),
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = adjdetail.gcode),
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = adjdetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = adjdetail.icode),
		UTN=adjdetail.adjutn,	
		HeaderNo=AdjHeader.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=AdjHeader.HeaderInvNo
	from adjheader, adjdetail, users
	where  adjheader.adjcode = adjdetail.adjcode and
			 adjdetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
			 adjheader.posted = 'Y' and
			 adjheader.usercode = users.usercode
	UNION ALL
	select  
		receiptdetail.Icode,
		type = 'RC-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), ReceiptHeader.ReceiptInvCode))),
		Postdate = ReceiptHeader.postdate,
		date = ReceiptHeader.postdate,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title=( Case ReceiptHeader.RecipientCode When 1 Then (Select Name From Department Where DeptCode=ReceiptHeader.deptcode) When 2 Then (Select Name From Accounts Where AccCode = ReceiptHeader.AccCode) When 3 Then (Select Name From Accounts Where AccCode = ReceiptHeader.AccCode) When 4 Then (Select Name From SalesMan Where SalesManCode = ReceiptHeader.RecipientSalesMan ) End),
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = ReceiptDetail.gcode),
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = receiptdetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = receiptdetail.icode),
		UTN=receiptdetail.receiptutn,	
		HeaderNo=ReceiptHeader.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=ReceiptHeader.HeaderInvNo
	from ReceiptHeader, ReceiptDetail, users
	where  ReceiptHeader.ReceiptInvCode = ReceiptDetail.ReceiptInvCode and
			 ReceiptDetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
			 ReceiptHeader.posted = 'Y' and
			 ReceiptHeader.salesmancode = users.usercode
	UNION ALL
	select  
		tdetail.Icode,
		type = 'TR-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), THeader.TransCode))),
		Postdate = THeader.postdate,
		date = THeader.postdate,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title= (Select Godown.name from Godown where Godown.GCode = THeader.sgcode),
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = THeader.dgcode),
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = tdetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = tdetail.icode),
		UTN=Tdetail.Transferutn,	
		HeaderNo=THeader.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=THeader.HeaderInvNo
	from THeader, TDetail, users
	where  THeader.TransCode = TDetail.TransCode and
			 TDetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
			 THeader.posted = 'Y' and
			 THeader.SalesMancode = users.usercode
	UNION ALL
	select
		d.Icode,
		type = 'AV-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), h.documentcode))),
		Postdate = h.postdate,
		date = h.postdate,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title = 'Item Price Adjustment',
		godown = NULL,
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = d.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = d.icode),
		UTN=isnull(d.utn, 0),
		HeaderNo=NULL,
		HeaderInvNo=NULL
	from  avgpriceadjheader h, avgpriceadjdetail d, users
	where h.documentcode = d.documentcode and	
			d.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
			h.posted='Y' and
			h.usercode = users.usercode) T
Order By itemname, utn, date
table.sort: itemname A, utn A, date A
